title: RAW_UNSCREENED: article-bearing head–modifier versus predicative property frames
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: use complete PGP40129 constructions to distinguish repeated article-bearing head–modifier frames from unprefixed property sequences, preserving a conditional whole reading without assigning Voynich symbol values.

design.architecture: A shared construction model classifies exact complete source and future target constructions as [article + head] [article + modifier] versus [head] [unprefixed property sequence]. It carries frame choice and modifier scope across a whole bounded record while leaving lexical values and language selection open.

source_evidence.quote: | recto 5 | `אלכוך. בארד רטב` | named noun followed by two unprefixed predicate/property candidates; useful contrast with the prefixed pattern above | medium |

design.conditional_whole_reading: Article-bearing pairs are provisionally attributive property frames; unprefixed sequences are provisionally predicative/state frames. Preserve all exact forms, article attachment, order, and record boundaries. No q/r/l or other Voynich symbol is assigned.
design.rival: Both surface classes are one flat property/list construction, with article placement reflecting formulaic or orthographic variation rather than grammar.
design.falsifier: Article-bearing and unprefixed classes do not remain distinct under a complete source inventory, or a held construction cannot distinguish the frame model from flat reuse without an occurrence-specific repair.
design.smallest_test: Freeze all complete occurrences in the three PGP40129 head-bounded records, classify exact frames, and define a held construction plus a flat-property rival before any target scoring.

design.scope_note: Exploratory source-backed architecture only. One historical leaf is not independent replication; missing meaning binding and target capacity remain open.
